name: Open Volleyball digit CNN v3
input: White foreground on black, float32 [1,1,28,28]; output 10 logits

training.adaptation: 63 audited score crops from 3 scanned source groups; 300 fixed steps with equal public rehearsal; a fourth source group excluded

limitations: Isolated digits only. Small local handwriting sample. Scores are not calibrated probabilities. Human review is mandatory.
